name: KORLIX Messenger
subtitle: Chats, voice and video calls
description:
Keep your KORLIX conversations together in a dedicated messaging app. Sign in with your existing KORLIX account to use your profile, connections and conversations.

Send direct and group messages, share photos, videos, files and voice notes, and express yourself with GIFs, stickers and message reactions. Format selected message text and see supported read receipts.

Connect with voice and video calls. Choose your appearance and accessibility preferences, manage your profile, and use blocking and reporting controls when needed.

KORLIX Messenger has its own sign-in session and works alongside KORLIX AI. A KORLIX account and internet connection are required. Camera and microphone access are requested for the features that use them.

KORLIX is for users aged 16 and older. Users aged 16 or 17 need permission from a parent or legal guardian.
review_notes: KORLIX Messenger is the standalone client for KORLIX Social. Existing KORLIX credentials are supported. Use two separate reviewer accounts/devices to verify calls and messaging. Direct conversations require an accepted connection, and group conversations require membership. Open Account & help for account support and Request KORLIX account deletion; the deletion request explains that it covers the shared KORLIX account. This iOS release can receive shared screens during a call; it does not include a ReplayKit broadcast extension for originating screen sharing. Dedicated reviewer credentials must be supplied securely in App Store Connect and verified before submission.
